Title: ZOTAC | Mini PCs and GeForce RTX Gaming Graphics Cards | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/page/zotac-gaming-geforce-rtx-super-series
Published: N/A
Author: N/A
Highlights:
The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® RTX SUPER™ series is powered by the award-winning NVIDIA Turing™ architecture with dedicated AI and ray-tracing cores for ultimate performance and graphics.

...

The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® RTX SUPER™ series come loaded with superfast GDDR6 memory and powerful GPU to unleash your creative productivity and gaming dominance.

...

THE STRONGEST

Finely tuned to extract every ounce of speed. AMP Extreme is the ultimate piece of engineering set to be the strongest in its class out of the box.

 

STRONG

Get more speed with AMP, factory overclocked ZOTAC GAMING GeForce graphics cards right out of the box. More speed, more performance.

 

THE SMALLEST

Small only in size. MINI delivers BIG performance.

 

ICESTORM 2.0

The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce® RTX SUPER™ graphics cards feature our most powerful cooling hardware. IceStorm 2.0 enables cooler, quieter, and stronger overall sustained performance. 

*available on select models

 

- ENGINEERED COOLING

With a dynamic layout utilizing more surface area, improved heatpipe layout, stronger aluminum array heatsink fin stack, and additional heat dissipation beyond the GPU means less heat and more overall sustained performance. 

*available on select models

 
- STRONGER

A die-cast metal jacket brace with full board coverage enhances the overall structural integrity to be stronger and more rigid than ever. Additional, it provides heat dissipation for other components. Together with a metal wraparound* backplate, it brings comprehensive support and protection. 

*available on select models

...

Two individual fan controllers allow users to adjust fan rotations independently and apply increased airflow only to where and when it’s needed, reducing overall noise and increasing longevity while still keeping things cool under the hood and performance going strong. It’s all done automatically so there’s nothing you need to do.

...

FREEZE

 Featuring fan stop. An inspired innovation that enables your powerful graphics card to become silent while reducing the wear and tear on the fan system. Greater system stability is achieved with precision temperature gauging and wider temperature tolerance. Fans start and stop at their pre-defined threshold automatically so game on. 

*available on 2080 SUPER AMP Extreme and 2080 SUPER AMP

 POWERBOOST A control chip providing live electrical current regulation and instant electrical deviation responses. POWERBOOST reduces ripple noise, minimizes power fluctuations, and has a high temperature tolerance, resulting in a longer lasting AMPed graphics cards. *available on 2080 SUPER AMP Extreme and 2080 SUPER AMP 

 16+4 POWER PHASES Spreading the load to 16 power phases means that no one power phase is overworked and building up too much heat. With more distribution of power, experience unparalleled stability operating at peak efficiency. *available on 2080 SUPER AMP Extreme and 2080 SUPER AMP

...

SPECTRA 2.0

 Equipped with more powerful Addressable LEDs, lighting and color are now both more fluid and dynamic. Enable new lighting effects introduced solely for SPECTRA 2.0 hardware. Make the ZOTAC GAMING graphics card yours and personalize it to the theme of your gaming PC with just a few clicks. Easily change the color, brightness, or lighting mode to just your liking. 

*available on 2080 SUPER AMP Extreme

---

Title: EVERYTHING IS SUPER WITH THE ALL-NEW ZOTAC GAMING GEFORCE RTX SUPER SERIES | ZOTAC
URL: https://www.zotac.com/us/news/everything-super-all-new-zotac-gaming-geforce-rtx-super-series
Published: 2019-06-28T04:06:54.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
ZOTAC GAMING GEFORCE® RTX 2080 SUPER™

The ZOTAC GAMING GEFORCE RTX 2080 SUPER Series pushes more CUDA Cores, faster GDDR6 memory speeds, and higher TDP for more power.

ZOTAC GAMING graphics cards continue to push the limit with each iteration. The ZOTAC GAMING GeForce RTX SUPER series all feature ZOTAC GAMING’s most powerful cooling, IceStorm 2.0. Featuring a full length or beyond, more powerfully designed aluminum array heatsink with dual or triple fan configuration, a dynamic combination of copper heatpipes strategically laid out for optimum heat transfers, structurally stabilized with a die-cast metal plate*, and overtly protected with the unique metal wraparound backplate*.

Get SUPER with models including the Super Compact ready to fit in 99% of builds, MINI. Get more power out of the box with the strong factory overclock AMP. Or get the strongest in its class, AMP Extreme. Expect SPECTRA lighting to provide the RGB lighting where you can customize the brightness and color with FireStorm, the ZOTAC GAMING graphics card fine tuning utility. DOWNLOAD the latest version of FireStorm to tap into more potential.
